# InternReach (Scientific Internship & Application Studio)
> Full-stack SaaS platform for scientific & embedded systems internship discovery, AI-driven motivation letter generation (3 variants), and candidate pipeline management.

## Core Architecture & Files
- [setup.bat]: Windows automated installation script (prerequisites check, venv creation, dependency installation, .env init).
- [start.bat]: Windows background launcher spawning FastAPI (port 8008) and Next.js (port 3005).
- [backend/main.py]: FastAPI entry point with CORS, lifespan startup worker, and router mounts.
- [backend/app/routers/search.py]: Dynamic multi-source search, AI keyword suggestions, and manual job import endpoints.
- [backend/app/routers/cv.py]: CV file upload (10 MB limit) and structured candidate profile persistence.
- [backend/app/routers/letters.py]: 3-variant motivation letter generator, refinement loop, ATS gap analysis, and interview preparation.
- [backend/app/routers/history.py]: Candidate application tracking CRM (status updates, deletion, full history).
- [backend/app/routers/worker.py]: Autonomous ingestion and tri-state HTTP liveness verification supervisor.
- [backend/app/routers/settings.py]: BYOK API key configuration with safe masked egress.
- [backend/app/services/agent_reach.py]: Aggregates live JobSpy scraping, DDGS web search, and ATS matching algorithms.
- [backend/app/services/registries.py]: Dynamic query generators and direct web scraping probes for French R&D job boards.
- [backend/app/services/worker.py]: Background thread worker performing scheduled sync and liveness verification sweeps.
- [backend/app/services/cv_parser.py]: Hybrid AI (Gemini/OpenAI/Claude) and regex parser for multi-column academic resumes.
- [backend/app/services/job_extractor.py]: SSRF-hardened HTML extraction with DNS multi-IP validation and manual redirect inspection.
- [backend/app/services/letter_generator.py]: LLM prompt engineering for Scientific R&D, Tech Agile, and Industrial Corporate cover letters.
- [backend/app/services/storage.py]: Local JSON-based persistence (`profile.json`, `history.json`, `jobs.json`, `settings.json`) under `STORE_LOCK` with `atomic_write_json`.
- [backend/tests/conftest.py]: Pytest test isolation fixture setting `INTERN_REACH_DATA_DIR` to a clean temporary directory.
- [backend/tests/test_api.py]: Integration tests for all REST API endpoints.
- [backend/tests/test_services.py]: Unit tests for services, SSRF defenses, deduplication, and atomic storage.
- [backend/tests/test_worker.py]: Unit and integration tests for background ingestion worker and settings.
- [frontend/src/app/page.tsx]: Main Next.js tab controller and dynamic component orchestrator.
- [frontend/src/lib/api.ts]: Frontend API client library with structured backend error extraction.
- [frontend/src/components/SearchSection.tsx]: Dynamic search UI with CV badges, domain filters, liveness toggle, and import modal.
- [frontend/src/components/CvSection.tsx]: CV upload with real-time profile form synchronization, domain manager, and project CRUD.
- [frontend/src/components/LetterStudio.tsx]: 3-version letter display, direct pitch cards, interview simulator modal, and feedback refinement loop.
- [frontend/src/components/HistorySection.tsx]: Candidate CRM table with interactive status dropdowns, letter modals, and delete actions.
- [frontend/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx]: BYOK modal, LLM provider selection, and worker trigger controls.
- [docs/API.md]: Comprehensive REST API documentation for all endpoints.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md]: High-level architecture, Mermaid sequence diagrams, security architecture, and design system contracts.
- [docs/adr/]: Architecture Decision Records (ADR-001 through ADR-004).

## Key Concepts

### Dynamic Ingestion & Anti-Bot Bypassing
InternReach does NOT use static JSON registries. It uses unauthenticated mobile REST API scraping (`JobSpy`) to query Indeed, LinkedIn, and Glassdoor without triggering browser-based Cloudflare interstitials, combined with live localized web queries (`ddgs`) targeting French defense, aerospace, and deep-tech portals (CEA, Inria, Thales, Safran, Welcome to the Jungle, Apec). All queries derive dynamically from the candidate's CV profile.

### Multi-Hop SSRF Defense
All user-supplied external job URLs undergo rigorous validation: scheme & port restrictions (HTTP/HTTPS on 80/443), DNS resolution with multi-IP parsing blocking private (RFC 1918), loopback, link-local, IPv4-mapped IPv6, and internal domains, followed by manual hop-by-hop redirect verification.

### Atomic Storage & Thread Safety
All persistence operations execute under a reentrant process lock (`STORE_LOCK`). Files are updated via `atomic_write_json` (`tempfile` + `os.replace`), eliminating race conditions and partial file corruption. Automated tests run against isolated temporary storage via `INTERN_REACH_DATA_DIR`.

### Tri-State Liveness Probing
Job listings decay rapidly. The background worker uses asynchronous HTTP probes with concurrency limits (8 tasks) to verify listings. Status codes 404/410 mark offers closed (`is_active: false`), 2xx/3xx mark them active (`is_active: true`), while 403/429 anti-bot responses and timeouts return inconclusive (`None`) and preserve the existing state without false-positive closures.

### 3-Tier Scientific Letter Personalization & Direct Outreach
Generic motivation letters fail in scientific recruitment. InternReach generates 3 distinct angles for every offer:
1. `scientific`: Focuses on research methodology, academic publications, state-of-the-art literature, and experimental rigor (adapted for CEA, Inria, CNRS).
2. `startup`: Emphasizes pragmatism, rapid prototyping, clean code, and cross-functional autonomy (adapted for robotics and deep-tech scale-ups).
3. `industrial`: Emphasizes system reliability, quality assurance, safety-critical norms (ISO 26262, DO-178C), and V-cycle engineering (adapted for Thales, Airbus, Safran).
Additionally, Letter Studio generates an accompaniment Cold Email and a recruiter LinkedIn connection note (<300 characters), alongside an interactive 5-question Technical Interview Simulator.

### Privacy & Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)
No user data, resumes, or keys are hosted on external servers. All data is saved locally in `backend/app/data/`. All LLM keys (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude) are masked in responses and never exposed to client-side telemetry. Keys are passed via secure HTTP request headers.

### Swiss Scientific Design System
The UI adheres strictly to the International Typographic Style: ultra-clean high-contrast typography (`JetBrains Mono` and `Inter`), clinical background (`#F8F9FA`), cobalt blue accent (`#0047AB`), and zero decorative emojis in production controls.
